claim.summary: Twist open band: over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with Boolean axioms at its top degree n (J its degree-n closure) and a twisted repair (lem:twist-window-trade's definition, rho(x_i)=x_i I for untwisted variables) at window W whose twisted variables are t hole variables on distinct pigeons and distinct holes: (a) at W = n with n >= 2 and m >= 2 it is scalar on nu (lem:top-window-twist-scalar); (b) if TW + tT + deg nu <= n, some coordinate of some u_sigma is a substitution repair at window W in J with multiplier degree <= deg nu + tT (lem:twist-window-trade (a) with room n; holds for any twisted Boolean variables on any system with D' for n); (c) with m, n >= 2, a twisted repair outside the scalar and substitution classes needs W <= n-1 and TW + tT + deg nu >= n+1; at T = 1 this includes one twist at tight room (W + deg nu = n, deg nu >= 1). A combination of the two recorded lemmas.
claim.assessment: Working proof, a combination of two recorded lemmas, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (a false count of twists withdrawn, m >= 2 added to (c)).

claim.summary: Over a field, R=k[x], J the degree-D' closure, rho:R->Mat_k(R) by commuting rho(x_i) of entry degree <=T>=1, nu a twisted repair at window D-K (soundness on axiom multiples within D-K, killing rho(wE_i)nu in J^k for deg(wE_i)<=D-K, survival rho(w)nu notin J^k), u_1=rho(x_1)nu, u_0=nu-u_1. (a) With Boolean axioms on x_1..x_t, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>t and room T(D-K)+deg nu<=D': rho(g)nu = rho(g|x1=0)u_0+rho(g|x1=1)u_1, and for deg g<=D-K-1 membership splits, so a vector u_eps is a twisted repair of the substituted map at window D-K-1 (soundness and killing of degree D-K dropped), room unchanged; after t splits some coordinate of some u_sigma is a substitution repair of x_1..x_t at window D-K-(t-s) when the room is T(D-K)+sT+deg nu. (b) If x_1..x_s are twisted, rho(x_i)=x_i I for i>s, each x_i-l_i is an axiom with l_i of degree <=1 in untwisted variables, and D-K+deg nu<=D', then rho(g)nu = g nu mod J^k for deg g<=D-K: a scalar repair at the full window, with no Boolean axiom and no entry bound. (c) In a domain model (J the degree-<=D' polynomials vanishing on finite X), with x_1^2-x_1 an axiom and D-K>=2, the split pieces of every g of degree <=D-K vanish on X with degree <=T(D-K)+T+deg nu: the full window is kept, measured at degree D'+T, survival unchanged.

claim.summary: Top-window twist scalarity: over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with Boolean axioms (hole axioms x_ij x_kj, pigeon axioms prod_j(1-x_ij), R=k[x]) with m >= 2 pigeons and n >= 2 holes, J its degree-n closure, and a twisted repair nu (lem:twist-window-trade's definition) at window n with room <= n whose twisted variables are hole variables on distinct pigeons and distinct holes: T = 1, deg nu = 0, rho(x)nu = x nu for every twisted x, and rho(g)nu = g nu for every g; such a repair exists exactly when the weight w is a repair (w not in C, wE_i in C). Proof: soundness at the pigeon axiom of x's pigeon, read on Y modulo the unplaced-pigeon indicators (cor:hole-occupancy-kernels (d), valid with Boolean axioms by lem:top-degree-axiom-inertness), and at the hole axioms through x force rho(x)nu = x nu. False at n = 1. On 3 pigeons, 2 holes, no repair of this class with weight x00 kills x11.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with a follow-up; it checked the m >= 2 proof order, the cylinder step, the n = 1 counterexample and the existence form; the Boolean-axiom membership transfer through lem:top-degree-axiom-inertness was checked by the author only.

claim.summary: Over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with m pigeons and n holes (multilinear ring or Boolean axioms) at its top degree D=n, Y the hole-respecting assignments, x=x_ab a hole variable, S a set of variables other than x, P = {x_kb: k!=a} union S and 1<=K'<=n-1: F = {f of degree <=K': p f in C for p in P} has a member outside C iff tau<=K', tau the number of distinct holes the variables of P lie in; then, if hole b is touched (b in H, e.g. m>=2), x prod_{j in H minus b}(1-sum_k x_kj), H the touched holes, lies in F minus C, a scalar repair x m with deg m = tau-1. Consequently, at any window W>=2 with room TW+deg nu<=n, a twisted repair with one twisted variable x, weight x and variable errors S (K'=T+deg nu<=n-1) implies, with b in H, a scalar repair with multiplier degree tau-1<=T+deg nu-1 for the same errors, at most deg nu when T=1 (necessary direction, via the pair identity of lem:twist-window-trade).
